content.text: You nailed that article. I got emotional all over again reading it. What a memorable random Wednesday night that turned out to be.
Thanks. That was a bear. 22 people, probably close to 11 hours of tape.
So I woke up last morning thinking it was the time to write what I knew about the sweatshop
Because the shifts start Monday. There seemed to be at least some hesitation with that e-mail and maybe if something gets out there, it would impact it differently

So I sent questions to Ilitch Holdings PR and then Colangelo did what Colangelo does, “This is a really good thing,” “no, that’s wrong, off the record (mandatory),” “Let’s talk Monday or Tuesday on it”
So he’s going to try to spin this.

He’s good at what he does but it’s still a story. Entry level sales people make about $20K in salary. Nobody is making commission. So getting paid that to work factory shifts, even for a good voluntary cause (of which this isn’t but let’s pretend here) is still interesting.  You can also get someone on record saying where the product is going.
